text: Ko onon yo gomɗimɓe ! Si maayde nden ɓaɗtike goɗɗo e mon, maande mayre heɓii mo, yo o seedintin wasiyee makko on nunɗuɓe ɗiɗo juulɓe maa worɓe ɗiɗo heereɓe -si on heɓaali juulɓe, si on setike maayde nden yanii e mon ton. Si on sikkitike seedeeyaagal maɓɓe ngal, darnee ɓe baawo julde woo, ɓe woondira Alla : ɓe yeeyirtaa geɓal maɓɓe ngal coggu, hay si tawii ko siɗɗo maɓɓe, e wonnde suuɗataa seedee Alla, e wonnde si ɓe waɗii ɗum, haray ɓe jeyaama e bakkondimɓe ɓen.
